parchment.name: Parchment
parchment.role: Light ground. Official paper, never gray.

flame.name: Flame
flame.role: Non-text accent on light grounds: BURN moments, display numerals, highlights. Never carries text on Parchment or White. ≤10%. On Midnight it is the text accent, because Ember is 3.25:1 there and fails: see accent-on-dark.

ember.name: Ember
ember.role: Fire at text size: primary buttons, links, labels, hovers.

families.use: Large headlines, 36px and up. Fine, engraved hairlines. Regular + Italic only. No bold exists.
Serif moments from 22–36px: pull quotes, the prophecy, document headings. Regular + Italic only.
Everything functional: body, nav, labels, buttons, sub-brand materials. Weights 400–700 with true italics.

stacks.serifDisplay: 'DM Serif Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif
stacks.serifText: 'DM Serif Text', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

typography.source: Google Fonts, free for every volunteer, partner, and field team
typography.retired: Proxima Nova, fully retired. Fallbacks: Georgia for the serifs, system sans for DM Sans.
typography.rule: Three faces and no others, in the weights and figures named here. A face outside the three is not a substitution, it is a different brand. Where a face cannot load, the fallbacks are Georgia for the serifs and the system sans for DM Sans.

button-hover.name: Button hover
button-hover.rule: Ember deepened ~10%. State-only. Never a palette color.

focus-ring.name: Focus ring
focus-ring.rule: Visible on every interactive element. Never removed.

success-state.name: Success state
success-state.rule: Forms and dashboards only. Never in brand layouts.

error-state.name: Error state
error-state.rule: Forms and dashboards only. Never Flame and never Ember: Ember means "this is the action", and an error is not an action.

warning-state.name: Warning state
warning-state.rule: Forms and dashboards only. Never Flame, which is a celebration colour and reads as one.

disabled-control.name: Disabled control
disabled-control.rule: Low contrast is the message. The only place the muted floor may be crossed.

touch-target.name: Touch target
touch-target.rule: Every control on every surface, however small it is drawn.

success-on-dark.name: Success on dark
success-on-dark.rule: The success state lifted for a dark ground. The light value is 2.4:1 on Midnight and cannot be read there.

error-on-dark.name: Error on dark
error-on-dark.rule: The error state lifted for a dark ground. Passes on Midnight and on Word Blue alike. Still never Flame.

warning-on-dark.name: Warning on dark
warning-on-dark.rule: The warning state lifted for a dark ground. Passes on Midnight and on Word Blue alike.

surface-on-dark.name: Surface on dark
surface-on-dark.rule: Parchment at 5% over Midnight. The raised card and panel ground on a dark page. Any lighter and the accent drops below 4.5:1 on it, which is what fixes this value rather than taste.

accent-on-dark.name: Accent on dark
accent-on-dark.rule: Flame. Ember is 3.3:1 on Midnight and fails, so a text accent on a dark ground is Flame. This is the one place Flame carries text, and §03 records it.

photo-video-scrim.name: Photo/video scrim
photo-video-scrim.rule: Required under any text on imagery (§07).

muted-text.name: Muted text
muted-text.rule: Captions and metadata. Nothing lighter. It fails contrast.

cssVariables.serif-display: 'DM Serif Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif
cssVariables.serif-text: 'DM Serif Text', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

ink-reversed-faint.use: Disabled controls on Midnight. The dark twin of ink-faint, and the only place the muted floor may be crossed on this ground.

wash-light.use: Input fills and raised panels on Midnight.

label.use: DM Sans 600, uppercase, letterspaced .18em. Eyebrows and kickers.

caption.use: DM Sans. Photo captions, metadata, datelines.

body-small.use: DM Sans. Card copy, table cells, secondary text.

body.use: DM Sans. Every extended reading passage.

title-small.use: DM Serif Text. The lowest the serif goes.

title.use: DM Serif Text. Document headings, pull quotes.

title-large.use: DM Serif Text. The prophecy, record openings.

display-large.use: DM Serif Display. Hero headlines only.

outcome-ministered.records: Ministered To. The conversation happened. The quietest of the six, because it is the most common.

outcome-salvation.records: Salvation. New life, and the reason for the rest. Green is life, not fire: fire is the institution’s own voice and is not lent to a data category.

outcome-healing.records: Healing. The color of oil, which is what the sick are anointed with.

outcome-baptism-spirit.records: Baptism in the Holy Spirit. Separated from water baptism by hue, because they are separate events and are counted separately.

outcome-raised.records: Raised from the dead. The rarest, and the furthest from every other value here.

scaleRules.neutral: Dividers, disabled states, input fills and table stripes are not new colours. They are Midnight on a light ground and Parchment on a dark one, at the opacities recorded here. Nothing lighter than ink-muted carries text, and ink-faint is disabled controls only.
scaleRules.type: Eleven steps and no sizes between them. Each names its family, so the size bands are not a rule anyone has to remember: pick the step and the family comes with it.
scaleRules.typeface-rules: Three faces and no others, in the weights and figures named here. A face outside the three is not a substitution, it is a different brand. Where a face cannot load, the fallbacks are Georgia for the serifs and the system sans for DM Sans.
scaleRules.scripture: A verse is not a pull quote and is not decoration. It is the one voice in this system that is not ours, and it is set so a reader can see that before reading a word of it. Never reflowed, never trimmed to fit, never paraphrased: if it does not fit, the layout changes.
scaleRules.outcome: Six, mutually distinguishable and distinguishable from Ember and Flame, in both themes and under all three dichromacies. Colour is never the only encoding: every outcome also carries its glyph and its written name.
scaleRules.progression: Nine ordered stages, fills only. Never text, and never an interactive control: the ramp runs close to Ember and ends on Flame, so a swatch that could be mistaken for a button stops a reader telling a stage from an action. Step 9 counts against the Flame budget.
scaleRules.spacing: A four-pixel base. Every margin, padding, gap and inset is one of these steps and nothing between them. The page edge inset is space-5 on every surface, a phone included, which is what this site itself uses.
scaleRules.radius: Three steps, no others. Nothing in this system is a pill, and nothing is a perfect circle except the avatar crop. A fully rounded control is not a radius this brand has: use radius-button.
scaleRules.elevation: Shadow is Midnight at low opacity, never black and never coloured. Four steps, and most of the system sits at the first two. A scrim is not an elevation step: it is a ground, and it belongs to the photography rules.
scaleRules.motion: Motion confirms an action. It never performs. Nothing bounces and nothing springs. A product may name its own interaction motions, and every one of them resolves to a duration and the easing published here rather than inventing its own curve. Every duration is suppressed entirely under prefers-reduced-motion.
scaleRules.breakpoint: Three, and the layout changes only at these. email is the narrowest anything is designed for and is why this brand governs email templates as a surface.

theme._README: This system is dual-theme and always was. Light is Parchment, dark is Midnight. Nothing here is a new colour: every value is a token already published above, collected into the pair an application switches between.
theme.derivation: There is no rule for deriving a dark value from a light one, and there should not be: every dark value here was chosen against a measured ratio on Midnight and on surface-on-dark, not lightened by a formula. Read the values.

contrast._README: Measured, not estimated. Computed by tools/colorkit.py at build time and gated by tools/brand_lint.py, so a palette edit that breaks a pair fails the build. Translucent tokens are flattened over the ground named here before measuring, because that is the colour a reader actually sees.

thresholds.note: Large is 24px, or 19px at 600 and above.

forbidden.why: Flame as text on the light ground. This is what the rule prevents.
Flame as text on a card. This is what the rule prevents.
Ember as text on the dark ground. Use accent-on-dark instead.

Word Blue as text on Midnight. It disappears.
Any text on a Flame fill. Flame is never a ground under text.

separation._README: CIEDE2000 distance, measured by tools/colorkit.py. The minimum across every pair in the set, under normal vision and each of the three dichromacies, simulated with Machado (2009) at full severity. The floor is 8.0. Colour is still never the only encoding: six categories cannot be told apart by hue alone by every reader at any separation, so every outcome also carries its glyph and its written name.
